description: This file defines the PHP class 'Setting' within the namespace Opencart.Admin.Controller.Startup, responsible for handling startup settings in the OpenCart admin panel. It includes methods to load configuration settings, set timezone, and output compression.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Controller class handling startup configuration settings for the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Loads settings from the database, applies timezone configurations, and sets response compression based on configuration values.
